rubric_yaml:
id: assistant-reply
version: "1.0.0"
description: test
model: jev-1.13.0
confidence_floors:
  read_only: 0.5
  standard: 0.65
  escalate: 0.8
  destructive: 0.9
thresholds:
  noul_yes: 0.75
  noul_no: 0.25
state_fields:
  screen: [prompt, reply]
questions:
  in_scope:
    type: noul
    stage: screen
    instructions: "Does reply address prompt?"
  quality:
    type: score
    stage: score
    stakes: standard
    instructions: "Quality?"
    criteria: [bad, ok, good]
routes:
  - when:
      in_scope: yes
      quality: 2
      quality_min_confidence: true
    route: pass
    reason: ok
  - when:
      in_scope: no
    route: fail
    reason: off
